Etiquette

A few notes for our guestsご出席の皆様へ

Giftsご祝儀

Your presence is all we could wish for. Just so you know, in Japan wedding guests traditionally give goshugi, a gift of money in a special envelope, at the reception desk.ご祝儀は当日受付にて頂戴いたします

Dress code服装

Formal. Please avoid white, which is reserved for the bride.フォーマルな装いでお越しください
白いお召し物は花嫁の色となりますのでお控えいただけますと幸いです

On the day当日について
